assumptions.thermal_capacity_basis: Unmeasured 1000 J/kg/K effective specific heat; bounds 500 to 2000. No manufacturer heat-capacity claim.
assumptions.aging_basis: Combine minimum initial capacitance with 30 percent relative loss and doubled initial maximum ESR; screening corner, not a lifetime prediction.
